# A2Z.com
> A2Z.com is Amazon’s corporate and employee information portal, publishing company news, leadership, policies, and workplace resources.

This site primarily serves as Amazon’s corporate hub, with content spanning company information, newsroom updates, investor and leadership materials, sustainability initiatives, and employee-focused resources.

## Company
- [About Amazon](https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us): Overview of Amazon’s business, mission, and company structure.
- [Leadership Principles](https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/leadership-principles): Amazon’s core operating principles and decision-making values.
- [Leadership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/leadership): Profiles of Amazon’s senior leadership team.
- [Our Businesses](https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/our-businesses): Summary of Amazon’s major business segments and services.
- [Amazon History](https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/amazon-history): Timeline and milestones from Amazon’s founding to today.
- [Working at Amazon](https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace): Information about Amazon’s workplace, culture, and employee experience.

## Newsroom
- [About Amazon News](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news): Central newsroom for Amazon announcements, stories, and updates.
- [Company News](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news): Corporate announcements and company-wide updates.
- [Innovation at Amazon](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/innovation-at-amazon): Stories about products, technology, and innovation efforts.
- [Policy News and Views](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/policy-news-views): Public policy updates, commentary, and regulatory perspectives.
- [Sustainability](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/sustainability): News and stories about Amazon’s sustainability initiatives.
- [Workplace News](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/workplace): Updates on jobs, employee programs, and workplace topics.

## Investor Relations
- [Investor Relations](https://www.aboutamazon.com/investor-relations): Entry point for Amazon financial reports, filings, and shareholder information.
- [Annual Reports and Proxy Statements](https://www.aboutamazon.com/investor-relations/annual-reports-proxies-and-shareholder-letters): Annual reports, proxy materials, and shareholder letters.
- [SEC Filings](https://www.aboutamazon.com/investor-relations/sec-filings): Access to Amazon’s regulatory filings with the SEC.
- [Quarterly Results](https://www.aboutamazon.com/investor-relations/quarterly-results): Earnings releases and quarterly financial performance materials.
- [Events and Presentations](https://www.aboutamazon.com/investor-relations/events-and-presentations): Investor events, webcasts, and presentation archives.
- [Corporate Governance](https://www.aboutamazon.com/investor-relations/corporate-governance): Governance documents, board information, and committee materials.

## Sustainability
- [Sustainability at Amazon](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet): Overview of Amazon’s environmental and sustainability commitments.
- [The Climate Pledge](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet/the-climate-pledge): Information about Amazon’s climate commitment and partner initiative.
- [Carbon-Free Energy](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet/carbon-free-energy): Details on renewable energy and carbon-free electricity efforts.
- [Sustainable Operations](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet/sustainable-operations): Programs to reduce operational environmental impact.
- [Packaging](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet/packaging): Initiatives to reduce packaging waste and improve recyclability.
- [Water Stewardship](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet/water-stewardship): Amazon’s water conservation and stewardship programs.

## Workplace and Careers
- [Workplace](https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace): Overview of employee experience, safety, and workplace culture.
- [Compensation and Benefits](https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/employee-benefits): Summary of employee pay, benefits, and support programs.
- [Workplace Safety](https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/workplace-safety): Information about safety programs and operational improvements.
- [Upskilling and Education](https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/upskilling-education): Career development, training, and education initiatives.
- [Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion](https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/diversity-equity-and-inclusion): Programs and commitments related to inclusion and representation.
- [Amazon Jobs](https://www.amazon.jobs/): Official Amazon careers and job search portal.

## Policy and Public Affairs
- [Public Policy](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/policy-news-views): Amazon’s public policy news, positions, and commentary.
- [Economic Impact](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/economic-impact): Stories and data on Amazon’s economic contributions.
- [Small Business Empowerment](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/small-business): Information about programs supporting independent sellers and small businesses.
- [Community Engagement](https://www.aboutamazon.com/impact/community): Overview of community investment and local impact initiatives.
- [Housing Equity Fund](https://www.aboutamazon.com/impact/housing-equity-fund): Information about Amazon’s affordable housing investment program.

## Community and Social Impact
- [Amazon Impact](https://www.aboutamazon.com/impact): Overview of Amazon’s community and social impact efforts.
- [Disaster Relief](https://www.aboutamazon.com/impact/disaster-relief): Programs supporting communities affected by natural disasters and crises.
- [Education and Skills Training](https://www.aboutamazon.com/impact/education-and-skills-training): Initiatives focused on education access and workforce development.
- [Community Giving](https://www.aboutamazon.com/impact/community): Local giving, volunteering, and community partnership programs.
- [Affordable Housing](https://www.aboutamazon.com/impact/housing-equity-fund): Amazon’s housing-focused community investment initiative.

## Media Resources
- [Media Resources](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/media-resources): Press contacts, assets, and media support information.
- [Amazon Logos](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/media-resources/amazon-logos): Official Amazon logo assets for media use.
- [Executive Headshots](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/media-resources/executive-headshots): Downloadable leadership photos for press and media.
- [Image and Video Gallery](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/media-resources/image-and-video-gallery): Curated media assets and visual resources.

## Additional Resources
- [Amazon Science](https://www.amazon.science/): Research publications, scientific advances, and technical work from Amazon teams.
- [AWS News Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/): Product announcements and technical updates from Amazon Web Services.
- [Amazon Developer](https://developer.amazon.com/): Developer platform for Alexa, Appstore, and Amazon device integrations.
- [Amazon Ads](https://advertising.amazon.com/): Information about Amazon’s advertising products and solutions.
- [Amazon Seller Central](https://sellercentral.amazon.com/): Portal for marketplace sellers managing Amazon storefront operations.
